title: GPU daily operational diary — 2026-06-15
summary: Short daily diary capturing per-cluster and per-pool utilization observations for the 24h window ending 2026-06-15 23:59 UTC. Purpose: runbook-style notes for on-call and infra planning; includes quick mitigations and follow-ups for capacity adjustments ahead of expected APAC evening surge.
observations:
- APAC evening window (18:00-22:00 UTC) caused sustained high util on cluster-alpha standard pool; average spiked from 72%->85% and we observed two short spill events into burst pool at ~18:07 and 19:30 UTC.
- cluster-beta reserved-enterprise stayed consistently above 85% for long tail of day; several customers reported degraded latency (JIRA-INC-3421). Bursts to enterprise backup capacity occurred automatically at 12:10 and 17:55 UTC.
- cluster-gamma shows moderate headroom but experienced a short-lived microburst at 21:30 UTC that raised 95p latency to 51ms; correlated with several large batch eval jobs scheduled by research (linear/INFRA-990).
- Low-priority and spot pools remain underutilized; opportunity to temporarily shift non-urgent batch work or model evals into these pools overnight (APAC off-peak).
- Noticeable fragmentation in alpha: many small single-GPU jobs preventing efficient slot packing; packing efficiency dropped ~6 percentage points vs baseline.
- No hardware failures observed. No increase in preemptions beyond normal for spot-cache pool.
actions:
1) Immediate (on-call) — increase autoscale burst threshold for cluster-alpha standard pool from +10% to +15% for next 48h to avoid customer latency regressions; owner: Liam. (Slack: #infra-alpha-ops)
2) Short-term (24-72h) — add temporary placement rule to allow research/linear/INFRA-990 batch jobs to be scheduled into cluster-gamma spot-cache between 02:00-08:00 UTC; owner: Ana.
3) Mid-term (1 week) — run a defragmentation job (packing sweep) on cluster-alpha to consolidate single-GPU jobs; automation PR: github.com/redwood-infra/prs/pack-sweep-231; owner: Maya.
4) Capacity request — open sales/eng sync to review reserved-enterprise uplift options for cluster-beta; prepare cost vs. SLA impact memo; owner: Sofia.
5) Monitoring tweak — add new alert for sustained 10-minute avg util >82% on reserved pools with a 5-minute suppress window to reduce alert noise; owner: SRE team.
6) Ops playbook update — add step in runbook to proactively migrate large evals to low-priority-burst during APAC evening window; owner: Maya.
follow_up:
- JIRA-INC-3421: incident owner to post postmortem update by 2026-06-20.
- Linear/INFRA-990: coordinate with research to shift next three eval runs to off-peak windows.
- PR pack-sweep-231: schedule canary run on alpha during Sunday maintenance (2026-06-21).
- Finance: estimate 72h cost of increasing burst capacity for beta and present to finance for approval.
runbook_notes:
Quick playbook excerpts for on-call.
- If reserved-enterprise triggers spill, verify reserved fallback capacity is healthy: run 'infractl pool status --cluster cluster-beta --pool reserved-enterprise'.
- To temporarily permit batch into spot-cache: patch placement rule 'allow-eval-nightshift' and set priority to 15.
- When packing sweep runs, schedule with 30-minute stagger to avoid synchronized eviction waves.
raw_queries:
- Grafana panel: GPU_FLEET:avg_util_by_cluster{window=24h} panel id=42
- Prometheus: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_pct[1h]) by (cluster,pool)
- Kusto (internal logs): clusters | where time > ago(1d) | summarize pct95(latency_ms) by cluster, pool
notes_to_self: Follow up on fragmentation root cause: early hypothesis is an increased number of short-lived inference-heavy jobs from a single customer; ask product contact for list of heavy customers and tags. Consider temporary reservation tagging for large customers.
